sources.title: Sources & Methodology
sources.fuel_desc1: Fuel prices are obtained in real time via the public REST API of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO) of the Government of Spain.
sources.fuel_desc2: For the calculation, the origin province is matched with the daily arithmetic average price across all gas stations in that province.
sources.routing_desc: Road distance calculation is performed by OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine) and addresses are geocoded using Photon (OpenStreetMap).
sources.wear_desc: An optional cost of 0.08 € per kilometer can be added to the fuel cost. This is a conservative estimate based on automotive association studies covering:
